name: Redcap

attributes.attribute: hat grew red from victim blood
wore iron boots and carried iron weapon
fled when a Bible was held up

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Redcap is a British folkloric spirit. He haunted old ruins. His little hat turned red from the blood he washed from victims. He frightened people to death at those ruins. He also had red eyes. Iron boots and a heavy iron weapon completed his dress, around wild hair. To drive him off, a person held up a Bible, and Redcap shrieked and vanished. He acted as a helpful brownie from time to time, but people usually avoided him.
